info.title: Sprøyt family app integration and Open Drinks authorization
info.description: I0 draft. Machine-readable handover; routes marked proposed are not a claim of deployment. Both systems require independent logged-in human approval and server credentials. App-scoped exports never include email, OIDC subject, global Sprøyt user ID or unanswered members. Only the transient privileged authorization exchange carries bootstrap verified email/internal moderator ID. MVP wire follows bounded core snapshots, numeric cursors, and member event field. Pagination from earlier prose is deferred; operations remain proposed until HTTP adapters are wired and tested.

x-activation-blockers: Open Drinks authorization counterpart implementation and shared contract agreement

get.summary: Current shared respondents, excluding unanswered members
get.description: MVP is one atomic snapshot of at most 1000 respondents. More than 1000 must fail; never silently truncate. No page_token or snapshot_id. Save changes_cursor atomically with the replacement. Future pagination requires a separately agreed consistent snapshot protocol.

get.summary: Ordered per-binding changes since committed cursor
get.description: At-least-once delivery. Historical upserts whose subject no longer shares become minimal response.revoked with no member. Other events carry current member. attributes.updated never represents a new user answer. Save cursor after local commit. Future retention expiry must fail 410; retention is not agreed.

post.summary: Register trusted pending authorization in Open Drinks
post.description: Hosted by Open Drinks, not Sprøyt. Service-authenticated. Expires <=300 seconds. Server stores exact context and fixed configured Sprøyt callback. Browser approval /integrations/sproyt/authorize?request_id= requires logged-in verified account and session admin (currently session created_by). No allowlist substitute. Codes are short-lived single-use, context-bound and never a user JWT.

post.description: Hosted by Open Drinks. Atomically consume code, require matching context and current session admin. Proof expiry <=300 seconds. verified_email must originate from server-verified account email; first link requires equality with current verified Sprøyt email. Subsequent links use immutable app/internal user ID mapping, never rematch by email. Sprøyt consumes proof once with pending state and rechecks current channel ownership/circle moderation plus actual channel access. Exchange happens outside DB transaction. On lost response restart authorization; do not reuse code with altered context.
